Remember silvereagle? (insert my real name here). Turns out the guy is a virgin, still hasn't gotten laid, not in the more than thirty years since we graduated from high school!' Word then spreads to anybody who ever knew me, ever. Including my sister, my cousins, my mother, and every work colleague and 'friend', past and present. I would be like Steve Carell's character Andy, the day after he is busted as a virgin; going to work and having everybody mock me for my virginity. It would be worse than Carell's character, because everybody I have ever known, including childhood friends and extended family, would know. You think this paranoid?
